name: Metric ring and link
oneLiner: a screenshot floats in a window and the camera eases in toward one row; a glowing hand-drawn ring loops around one or two real numbers on it, a leader line runs out from each ring and the lines meet at a glass card beside the window that names what the number means
say: when the speaker reads a number off a screen and says what it means ('see this, that is why it worked'): the ring draws on the number, the card lands on the meaning. Set rings to the real numbers in % of the screenshot (x,y,w,h; up to 2, separated by ;), title and sub to the meaning
